[/font][/center][/size][/b][font=Arial][size=3]Hihi everyone! I hope you enjoy my silly mod, this took me months because I'm an expert in procrastination! [/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=4][b]
Installation guide:[/b][/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]

1- Download the file
2- Extract it in your Stardew Valley/Mods
3- Install all the dependencies, and enjoy!

I did the code (with tons of help) so you don't have to manually replace all files, pretty neat, right? (< Literally the bare minimum) 

[left][font=Courier New][size=4][b]Requirements![/b][/size][/font][/left]
1- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] - Without this amazing mod you'd have to replace all manually! (Or you could still do it manually if you want...?)
2- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family Custom NPCs[/url]﻿ and all its requirements! - Why would you want the portraits if you don't have the original mod?
Anyways, [b]go endorse those mods please![/b] Without those this wouldn't be possible! <3

[font=Arial][size=3][font=Courier New][size=4][b]Bug reports!
[/b][font=Arial][size=3]Thanks to my beta testers this should be functional, but if you see any bug PLEASE report it! This is my first mod and I expect tons of silly bugs!
You can report it on discord (preferred) or here in nexus, it would mean the world to me if you report a bug!
Here's my discord tag:
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3][font=Arial][size=3][font=Courier New][size=4][font=Arial][size=3]heartofflowers

I'm also very active in the [url=https://discord.gg/rCvMxmt5PP]East Scarp discord server[/url]﻿ if you wanna visit me there! [/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][b]

[/b][/size][/font][/size][/font][i]
I'll yap a bit about the basics of the mod so feel free to skip this part[/i]

I made this mod hoping to blend these characters with the vanilla art style (I swear I tried my best!), there's no other purpose for this mod, I just like the vanilla art style and I share this with you in case you want the same for your game. The main goal was to be as closer as the original as I could, for some characters the only changes made were purely color palettes, and a bit of zoom. I took very few creative liberties (you can see them below!), and those were mainly clothing wise.
This mod originally started as a personal use mod, but after receiving support from the community I kept going, and turns out people in nexus also wanted this mod, so here it is! I apologize for the months of waiting, it's finally done!
This mod includes all seasonal outfits for each character, it also includes a fluffier version of Sassy because I like making my life harder.
If you want to use my art as a reference feel free to do so, but do not post my art nor steal it for your mod, I'd be more than happy to help if you ask nicely in discord! I'd normally be less protective of my art, but this took months and I did it from scratch, so I think I have a point here :D
